en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing sailing boats with large lateen sails passing through an open metal drawbridge or swing bridge over a wide river. On the right, the bridge deck is raised or pivoted, with people standing near the edge; on the left, a lattice metal span rests on stone piers. Riverside buildings are faintly visible in the background. French captions and a handwritten signature appear on the front.
